tagline: Global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting
hero_kpi_rationale: Marsh Risk revenue is a key indicator of the company's performance, representing 54% of total revenue in 2025, with 15% growth on a reported basis and 4% on an underlying basis

kpis.name: Marsh Risk Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the Marsh Risk division, the world's leading insurance broker and risk advisor
kpis.description: Marsh Risk revenue in 2025. Indicator tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the past six years.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth driven by organic growth and McGriff acquisition

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated revenue from all business segments including Risk and Insurance Services and Consulting
kpis.signal: Solid consolidated revenue growth with 10% reported and 4% underlying growth

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating income before interest and taxes
kpis.signal: Operating income grew 7% year-over-year to 6.2 billion, driven by revenue growth partially offset by increased expenses

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to the Company after all expenses and taxes
kpis.description: Net income attributable to the Company in 2025
kpis.signal: Net income attributable to the Company reached 4.2 billion with 2% year-over-year growth, partially offset by higher interest expense from McGriff acquisition debt

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.explanation: Earnings per share on a diluted basis
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS increased 3% to 8.43 dollars, reflecting higher operating income partially offset by increased interest expense

kpis.name: Risk and Insurance Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from risk management, insurance/reinsurance broking conducted through Marsh Risk and Guy Carpenter
kpis.description: Risk and Insurance Services revenue in 2025
kpis.signal: Risk and Insurance Services segment revenue grew 12% with 4% underlying growth, driven by Marsh Risk expansion

kpis.name: Consulting Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from health, wealth and career advice, solutions and products, and specialized management consulting services
kpis.signal: Consulting segment revenue increased 7% with 5% underlying growth, driven by Mercer and Marsh Management Consulting

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin as a service business does not have traditional COGS
kpis.signal: Not applicable for professional services and brokerage business model

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of total revenue
kpis.signal: Operating margin declined slightly from 23.8% to 23.1%, reflecting higher expense growth than revenue growth

kpis.name: R&D
kpis.explanation: R&D spending as percentage of revenue
kpis.signal: Not separately disclosed; professional services business model

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Annual capital expenditures for property, plant and equipment
kpis.signal: Not separately disclosed in MD&A; asset-light services business model

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Multiple major wars, global conflicts, social unrest, tariffs, slower GDP growth or recession, FX fluctuations, interest rate changes, capital markets volatility and inflation could materially impact business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance and Changing Laws
risks.score_rationale: Company cannot guarantee compliance with complex and evolving US federal, state and foreign laws and regulations; non-compliance could have material adverse effects; emerging AI-related laws add complexity

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: Company handles sensitive client and customer data; breaches or failures to protect information systems could result in significant liability, reputational damage, and regulatory penalties

risks.title: Fiduciary and Professional Liability
risks.score_rationale: Company is subject to significant uninsured exposures arising from errors and omissions, breach of fiduciary duty and other professional liability claims

risks.title: Competitive Pressures
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in competitive environment requiring differentiation to attract and retain clients; competition impacts market share and revenue growth

risks.title: Third-Party Dependencies and Conflicts of Interest
risks.score_rationale: Business relies on third-party providers and introducers; inability to effectively identify and manage conflicts of interest could harm business and reputation

risks.title: Reputational Risks
risks.score_rationale: Company's reputation as trusted advisor is critical to business; breaches, failures, or regulatory issues could significantly damage reputation and client confidence

ai_positioning.summary: Marsh McLennan acknowledges emerging AI-related regulatory risks including the EU AI Act, but does not explicitly position AI as a core business driver or investment area in the current fiscal year reporting.
evidence: The Company notes exposure to emerging AI-related laws such as the EU's AI Act in its risk factors
Risk Factor Item 1A mentions costs to comply with emerging AI-related laws and their potential adverse effects
